description: This file defines the 'StartStreaming' class, which represents a message to initiate streaming of entities of a specified type via a connection. It includes a builder for constructing instances with various parameters such as namespace filters, extra fields, and authorization context.

classes.name: StartStreaming
classes.description: An immutable message class used to request the start of a streaming session with specific parameters such as streaming type, connection ID, authorization context, namespaces, filters, and extra fields.

classes.name: StartStreaming.StartStreamingBuilder
classes.description: A builder class providing a fluent API to construct 'StartStreaming' instances with optional parameters.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new builder instance for 'StartStreaming', initializing core required parameters.

methods.name: getStreamingType
methods.description: Returns the type of streaming (e.g., entity type) that is to be started.

methods.name: getConnectionCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the identifier used to correlate the connection/session.

methods.name: getAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Returns the authorization context associated with this streaming request.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Returns a list of namespace strings for which the streaming applies.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an optional filter string to be applied to filter events before streaming.

methods.name: getExtraFields
methods.description: Returns an optional 'JsonFieldSelector' to enrich outgoing signals with additional fields.
